trips.route_note: Washington State Ferries sail directly from downtown Seattle's Colman Dock to Winslow in about 35 minutes; the town center is a short walk from the ferry terminal.
trips.tour_query: Bainbridge Island ferry day trip from Seattle
trips.why: The ferry crossing is only about 35 minutes, but the island's sights are spread out beyond the walkable Winslow town center, so a tour handles the last-mile problem.
know: Ferries run frequently from Colman Dock and the town center is a short walk from the terminal
Go on a clear day for the best views of the Seattle skyline and Mount Rainier
